---
applyTo: "harness/**,tools/**,tests/*test.mjs,.github/**,.claude/**"
---

Harness changes require their own requirement/evidence and independent review. Canonical skills live in harness/skills; generated provider copies must not be hand-edited. Run npm run agent-assets:sync, npm run harness:check and npm run test:harness. Policy, verifier, budget and release thresholds cannot be weakened by the implementing loop.
